acceptance_signals: One accepted architecture decision contains a concise Kernel Constitution with the four-part philosophy, four design principles, critical distinctions, and four admission questions.

The architecture baseline distinguishes Kernel state semantics from Application storage and orchestration, Policy selection, Adapter mechanics, Consumer Context ownership, Experiment maturity, and cross-cutting per-transition enforcement claims.
Completion verification remains distinct from bounded handoff, and the minimum governed journey preserves both stages.
A lightweight dated classification covers current major contract families, records overlaps and uncertainties, and is explicitly diagnostic rather than a permanent governed ledger.

Affected README, status, governance model, development plans, invariants, and development log agree that new Kernel promotion is paused pending concrete journey evidence while Application, Adapter, and consumer work may continue.
External consumer selection, required checks, branch protection, merge proof, commit, push, release, and deployment remain outside this task.
Focused documentation tests and the complete Python unit suite pass; repository governance reports no new deterministic failure.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-8a4c850b7ddc47b3a5d35a1f0e03745d and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Record the converged repository-local AgentGov Kernel Constitution, add a lightweight diagnostic classification of current major contracts, and synchronize affected architecture sources of truth without changing runtime behavior, schemas, release identity, external consumers, or Git state.

items: The Constitution could become longer or more procedural than the minimum sufficient baseline.
Classification could be mistaken for a permanent runtime layer map or trigger premature module/schema movement.
Source-of-truth documents could diverge if terminology or the external-authority boundary is updated inconsistently.
Documentation could overstate control-plane or enforcement capability without real consumer proof.
Reviewed assumption: The resolved alignment authorizes only a repository-local documentation and diagnostic-classification slice.
Reviewed assumption: Existing development runtime and schema behavior remain unchanged.
Reviewed assumption: The current published stable and release-candidate identities remain unchanged.
Reviewed assumption: The pre-existing untracked .codex directory is unrelated user state and remains untouched.

title: Establish the minimum sufficient Kernel architecture baseline
